name: Color Cube
author: JTHurley
description: A really fun game! The objective is to have the cube make as many successful jumps onto the platforms as possible. In order for the jump to be a success, the cube must land with its top color matching the platform's color that it landed on. To do this, press the spacebar near the edge of the platform to jump and then tap the arrow keys to rotate the cube 90 degrees in the corresponding directions. Note that you can rotate the cube sideways while on the ground but can only rotate the cube forward and backwards while it's in the air. Post your high score in the comments section.
